📜 Game Rules: King of Tokyo
You play as a giant monster battling for control over Tokyo.
There are 2 ways to win:
🏆 Reach 20 Victory Points
💀 Be the last monster standing

🎲 On Your Turn:
1. Roll up to 3 times with 6 dice.
2. Choose which dice to keep or reroll.
3. Resolve the dice effects:
 • 1 / 2 / 3: Gain Victory Points if you roll 3+ of the same number.
 • 🐾 Claw: Damage other monsters.
 • ❤️ Heart: Heal yourself (only if not in Tokyo).
 • ⚡ Energy: Gain energy cubes to buy Power Cards.

🗼 Tokyo Rules:
• If Tokyo is empty, you must enter.
• While in Tokyo:
 - You gain 1 VP on entry.
 - You gain 2 VP if you start your turn in Tokyo.
 - You can’t heal with ❤️ dice.
 - When attacked, you may leave Tokyo, letting your attacker enter.

🃏 Power Cards:
• Spend ⚡ energy to buy cards with special powers.
• 2 types of cards:
 - Action (one-time effect)
 - Power (permanent effect)

Good luck, monster! 👾 May you become the true King of Tokyo!
